summary: Friday 10-23. Today's input has no new adverse 8-K items (no 4.01, 4.02 or 5.02 inside the window other than the SMG 5.02 from 10-16, still unread). Per L2 I checked each name's own estimate and filings rather than only flagged names; SAM and VRSN have now reported and MSCI's 10-27 estimate is stale.

notable.headline: Boston Beer Q3: adj EPS $4.21 beats $4.20, sales $520.1M miss $522.8M, net revenue -3.2%; lowers FY26 shipments and depletions guidance, raises adj EPS guidance low end to $9.00-$10.50 vs $8.87 est
notable.read: Mixed. Volume guidance cut and slightly missed sales are fundamentally weaker than the headline EPS beat; the raised EPS floor is a margin/cost story. A conflicting 'CORRECTION' headline says adj EPS $4.37, so the EPS beat size is unclear; the volume guide cut is the cleaner negative. Continues the 10-20/21 'underperformance unlikely to change' RBC theme.
